researchNotes: Official Shopify feed (kayali.com/en-ae) lists 37 full-size fragrances in scope (100ml/50ml EDP and EDP Intense); bundles, minis, body/hair care, home fragrance and limited editions skipped. All notes come from the official product descriptions (noteSource official). Fleur Majesty Rose Royale 31: its product text is identical to Invite Only Amber's, so no notes were recorded. Vanilla Royale Sugared Patchouli 64 has an empty description: name and sizes only. Pyramid tiers only where the text names opening/heart/base. Country not stated on the pages read.

fragrances.name: Boujee Kitty Caramel Milk 22

sources.name: Vivir — Kayali Boujee Kitty Caramel Milk 22

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review page rates longevity 4/5 and sillage 3/5; no official or independent wear figures found, and Vivir's product naming is inconsistent.

fragrances.name: Freedom Musk Matcha 45
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scentverdict: moderate longevity (4-6 h) and moderate projection; Vivir editorial scores 3/5 for longevity, projection and sillage (community 3.5 / 3.2).

fragrances.name: Freedom Musk Latte 41
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: longevity 3/5 (about 4-6 h, may fade to skin scent), sillage 3/5, projection 2/5, soft approachable aura.

fragrances.name: Freedom Musk Bouquet 27
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir: longevity 4/5, projection and sillage 3/5; WhatScent community averages lower (longevity 3.3, projection 3.2, sillage 2.8). Rounded middle view.

fragrances.name: Freedom Musk Santal 34

sources.name: The Daily Beast — Kayali musk perfume review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Daily Beast review: impressive longevity, warm base lasts through the day; Perfumes.la lists longevity and sillage as moderate; Taksima says moderate-to-strong.

fragrances.name: Eden Sweet Peach 35
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scentverdict: moderate longevity (4-6 h) and projection; Perfumes.la: moderate/moderate; Sephora UK reviewers split (some say long-lasting, one says not crazy).

fragrances.name: Eden Plush Pear 23
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir: longevity 3/5 (about 4-6 h), sillage 3/5, projection 2/5 (intimate); Perfumes.la lists moderate/moderate.

fragrances.name: Musk 12
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scentverdict: moderate longevity (4-6 h); Parfumo reviewers mostly call sillage soft/intimate (one reports about 10 h on skin); retailer copy claims excellent longevity.

fragrances.name: Oudgasm Chocolate Oud 11
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scentverdict: long longevity (6-10 h), moderate projection; Vivir rates longevity lower (2/5) and sillage 3/5; one Parfumo reviewer reports about 8 h on skin.

fragrances.name: Maldives in a Bottle Ylang Coco 20

sources.name: Kayali — Maldives in a Bottle Ylang Coco 20
Fragplace — Maldives in a Bottle Ylang Coco 20 FAQ

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Fragplace: moderate longevity (4-6 h), moderate sillage close to skin; another profile lists soft-to-moderate; a review suggests it suits summer days.

fragrances.name: Yum Pistachio Gelato 33
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Khayest listing: lasts about 6-8 h, moderate sillage; Vivir 4/5 longevity, 3/5 sillage; Scento suggests autumn/winter and evening/night; thescentbase gives ~3 h (outlier).

fragrances.name: Yum Boujee Marshmallow 81
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Database: moderate longevity, 4-6 h (3.3/5), sillage close to skin (2.7/5); Vivir: 4/5 longevity (6-8 h), 3/5 sillage; Scento: moderate longevity.

fragrances.name: Utopia Vanilla Coco 21

sources.name: Fragrance Review — Kayali Utopia Vanilla Coco

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Perfumes.la: moderate to long-lasting with moderate sillage; Fragrance Review says longevity and sillage are unremarkable and reapplication may be needed.

fragrances.name: Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar 42
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Retailer-style review: about 6-8 h on skin, moderate to strong sillage; Perfumes.la lists moderate/moderate. Middle view used.

fragrances.name: Vanilla 28
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Fragplace (user reviews): typically 6-10 h, longevity and sillage 4/5; Parfumo community averages 7.4/10 longevity, 7.1/10 sillage; individual reports vary widely. Sillage set to moderate.

Scentbase — Maui in a Bottle Sweet Banana 37
Perfumes.la — Maui in a Bottle Sweet Banana 37

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Thescentbase: intimate projection, average about 3 h; Perfumes.la: moderate/moderate; Parfumo reviewer: faded after about 3 h; Cult Beauty reviewers say it fades faster than expected.

sources.name: Kayali — Marrakesh in a Bottle Orange Blossom 24
Scentverdict — Kayali Marrakesh in a Bottle Orange Blossom 24

Scentbase — Capri in a Bottle Lemon Sugar 14

sources.name: Fragplace — The Wedding Velvet Santal 35 FAQ
Scentverdict — Kayali The Wedding Velvet Santal 35

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Fragplace: moderate longevity, typically 4-6 h (3/5), moderate sillage close to skin; Scentverdict also 4-6 h with intimate sillage; WhatScent users rate longevity 2/5, sillage 3/5.

Vivir — Kayali Sweet Diamond Pink Pepper

fragrances.name: Oudgasm Vanilla Oud 36
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Cult Beauty reviewer: lasts hours without reapplying; Perfumes.la: moderate to long-lasting, moderate sillage; Scentverdict: strong projection, better for evenings; several sources call it suited to cooler seasons.

sources.name: Man For Himself — Kayali Oudgasm Tobacco Oud review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Man For Himself review: longevity 4/5, sillage 4/5; Parfumo users 7.7/10 longevity, 7.5/10 sillage (few ratings); Scentbase gives about 3 h average.

fragrances.name: Eden Juicy Apple 01
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Perfumes.la: moderate longevity and sillage; Sephora UK reviewer: a few hours on skin, soft-to-medium sillage; Scentverdict page also found.
